explain.stockBody: Every vehicle carries its own supplies (foam, absorbent, medical kits…) and uses them up according to how hard the mission is and the conditions on scene. When it runs low it reloads at base on its own; otherwise it is ready for the next call straight away.
explain.fuelBody: Vehicles have an autonomy in kilometres: every journey uses it up, and so do pumps, ladders and generators working on scene. Below a quarter of a tank the vehicle refuels on its own once the mission is over. It never runs dry, and fuel costs no extra Credits.
explain.flightBody: Helicopters and planes have an endurance in minutes of flight: take-off, every leg, the time over the scene and every water scoop use it. When only what it needs to fly home with its reserve is left, the aircraft leaves the scene, refuels for free at its base and then flies back to the emergency on its own, if it is still open.
